chunks: They will turn towards one another, asking each other questions.
ai.seo_question: What are people doing towards each other on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this scene on the Day of Judgment illustrates the shift from individual accountability to collective social reckoning, where the righteous and wicked alike engage in mutual inquiry. It underscores the theme of 'mutual questioning' as a form of divine justice, reflecting how human relationships and shared fates become central to the final assessment of deeds.
